sentences.text: Snowden is a 2016 American-German biographical political thriller film directed by Oliver Stone and written by Stone and Kieran Fitzgerald , based on the books The Snowden Files by Luke Harding and Time of the Octopus by Anatoly Kucherena .	Oliver Stone	Oliver Stone	The Snowden Files	The Snowden Files	Luke Harding	Luke Harding	Anatoly Kucherena	Anatoly Kucherena	biographical	Biographical film	political thriller	political thriller

The cast includes Joseph Gordon-Levitt as the title character , Edward Snowden , with Shailene Woodley , Melissa Leo , Zachary Quinto , Tom Wilkinson , Scott Eastwood , Logan Marshall-Green , Timothy Olyphant , Ben Schnetzer , LaKeith Lee Stanfield , Rhys Ifans and Nicolas Cage also starring . Filming began on February 16 , 2015 in Munich , Germany .	Munich	Munich	Germany	Germany

Snowden screened at Comic-Con on July 21 , 2016 , before premiering at the 2016 Toronto International Film Festival on September 9 , 2016 .	Comic-Con	San Diego Comic-Con International	2016 Toronto International Film Festival	2016 Toronto International Film Festival
The film was theatrically released in the United States on September 16 , 2016 , by Open Road Films and on September 22 in Germany .	Open Road Films	Open Road Films	Germany	Germany
It received mixed reviews and was a box office disappointment , grossing $ 37.3 million worldwide against its $ 40 million budget .	box office disappointment	box office bomb
